name: Spartoo SAS
summary: Spartoo SAS operates as an online retail destination specializing in footwear and fashion accessories for all ages, including men, women, and children. Its diverse product offering encompasses a wide range of shoe styles such as sneakers, sandals, ballet flats, pumps, and boots, in addition to a variety of bags and apparel. By June 4, 2021, the company had also established a physical presence, managing six retail outlets and three dedicated brand corners. Spartoo serves a broad international customer base, with significant operations in France, Germany, the United Kingdom, Italy, and Spain. The company was founded in 2006 and maintains its headquarters in Grenoble, France.
